mechanism: Amikacin nephrotoxicity may impair amlodipine clearance and increase its plasma concentrations, while amlodipine-induced vasodilation may theoretically increase aminoglycoside renal delivery and toxicity risk.
action: Monitor renal function closely during concurrent use; assess blood pressure regularly and adjust amlodipine dosing if renal impairment develops; ensure adequate hydration and consider alternative antibiotics if possible.
